title: SosEvent
description: SOS event payload — published to meshsat/{device_id}/sos MQTT topic AND returned from GET /api/sos/recent.

event_id.description: UUID v4 unique per SOS event (lowercase hex, dash-separated)

detected_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the detector flagged the event

source_topic.description: The MQTT topic the source MO message arrived on (typically meshsat/{device_id}/mo/decoded)

keyword_matched.description: Present when detection_reason=keyword; the literal token that matched
